consumer_scope: Compilation only; WGMMA uses explicit overrides outside p02-tfr qualification.
digest_policy: Every pre-existing sha256/log_sha256/record_sha256 field inside embedded records still identifies ORIGINAL RAW BYTES. It is never rewritten to claim that normalized bytes are original. Use each bundled file's published_sha256 and inventory.json to check the normalized content. The exporter checks retained raw log bindings before normalization.

limitations: This packet does not execute a full SimX processor, native RTL, WGMMA, vendor emulator or physical device.
Host model/function tests are not whole-processor SimX execution.
Passing fixture checks reproduce the frozen bytes; they do not qualify matrix execution.
The full unittest suite includes expected negative subprocess cases; a passing suite does not mean every deliberately rejected child invocation exited zero.
Governance preflight does not search configured tools outside PATH and does not require initialized GPU submodules.
Baseline packet consistency checks do not reverify raw unpublished log bytes or the raw-to-published redaction relationship.
Resource limits are polled budgets; peaks between samples and descendants leaving the monitored process group are outside the monitor guarantee.
Reported suite RSS is the outer monitored process group, not an aggregate peak across nested host-test helpers that create and bound separate process groups.
Executable hashes identify the observed host tools; this packet does not claim a complete host-system dependency inventory.
No phase acceptance, maintainer approval, waiver or hosted CI result is established by this packet.

resource_budget.note: The shared wrapper records the session jobs ceiling as two; this sequential suite was assigned one host compile worker.

limitations: Header bodies/toolchains and executables are excluded; identity manifests retain their hashes.
Dirty-tree diagnostics retain their historical state; only corrected formal records claim the clean candidate.
The original stall failure lacks a preserved pre-fix harness byte snapshot; no corrected hash is substituted.
Leaf enable stalls do not establish WGMMA or whole-processor layout correctness.
